sources: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 4335 (all pages via campsitePaging.do, 66 campsites + 1 tent shelter parsed)

values.note: ReserveAmerica or 1-800-456-2267, up to 9 months ahead, same day included; 1-night stays allowed for campsites. Maximum 14 continuous nights, then 48 hours away before registering again.

booking.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/schodack-island-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=4335 (Booking Window: Campsite 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 9 Month(s) in advance'; 'This campground allows 1-night stays for campsites only.'; LENGTH OF STAY 'maximum of 14 continuous nights'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Sites 1-43 have 50-amp electric (50- and 30-amp 220 V plus a 20-amp GFI outlet); sites 44-67 have none; no water or sewer at sites.

hookups.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/schodack-island-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=4335 ('Sites 1-43 offer 50 amp electric. This includes a (220 volt) 50 amp and 30 amp outlet, and a (110 volt) 20 amp Ground Fault outlet. Sites 44-67 are non-electric campsites.') + site list ('Electric Hookup available: 50 amp' 42, 'Electric Hookup - no' 24, 'Full Hookup - no' all), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 66 campsites in Creekside and Riverside loops plus overflow; 11 pull-throughs (ten listed at 50 ft), the rest 30-ft back-ins.

sites.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/schodack-island-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=4335 ('Camping - the park has 66 campsites available'; 'Campsite (66)') + site list (Equip length/Driveway '50 Pull-Through' 10, '30 Pull-Through' 1, '50 Back-In' 2, '30 Back-In' 34, '30' 19), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/schodack-island-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=4335 ('The park's facilities include campsites, boat launch, playground, a nature trail, picnic tables and pavilions and showers'; Services and Amenities 'Dump Station', 'Showers', 'Water'), read 2026-10-21

note: OPRHP on Schodack Island (Hudson River). No water-view sites (river via trails). A carry-in / carry-out park. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on ReserveAmerica (parkId 4335): 66 campsites, pull-throughs to 50 ft, reservable, phone (518) 732-0187, 2027 season by loop (matches). Added 9-month window, 1-night stays allowed, 14-night max, 50-amp at sites 1-43 (the note's 'all with electric' was wrong: 44-67 have none), showers, dump, water. Fees left as read 2026-10-12. Note trimmed of site/electric/length/booking text.
